items.guidance: In this Express app, look for the main server file where the app is created and middleware is registered; if an existing unauthenticated route (such as an API status or ping route) already returns 2xx, report its path. If adding a route, place app.get for the health path ahead of any auth, passport, CSRF, or host/redirect middleware, and have it respond on port 3000 without touching MySQL or Redis.

The detected start command already runs npm run migrate before npm start, so check package.json for the migrate script (likely a Knex migrate command if knex is a dependency) and report its exact non-interactive form. Report that command for Deployz's per-release migration step, and note whether the migrate prefix in the start command duplicates that step.

Check where bull queues are created and where their process handlers are registered, and whether that module is imported by the Express server entry (in which case jobs already run in the web process). Report whether a separate worker entry file or package.json script exists, and whether the queues depend on Redis configuration that would need to be supplied per deployment.
